name: Tugays
description: Uruguayan online store for home, kitchen, bathroom and organization items, toys and small household appliances, with branches in Montevideo. Ships nationwide at a flat fee and offers free pickup in branches.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de hogar, cocina, baño, organización, juguetes y electrohogar, con sucursales en Montevideo. Envía a todo el país con costo fijo y ofrece retiro gratis en sucursales.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide at a flat fee; Montevideo and interior 3-5 business days via carriers chosen by the store

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at branches in Montevideo (Pablo de Maria, Roxlo, Paso Molino and two on Av. 8 de Octubre); the customer is notified when the order is ready.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.
